learning_outcomes.text: Name the basic design requirements, calculate tolerances and fits, and explain the most important connection elements. They apply software for creating design drawings.
Reproduce the essential knowledge for the strength-based design of pressure vessels. They outline regulations and standards for placing pressure vessels on the market and operating them.

Recognize how basic knowledge from the areas of strength of materials, materials science, design, and partly thermodynamics are brought together and applied in practice in this subject. They apply regulations.

Dimension pressure vessels according to the given process data based on the relevant regulations and select suitable materials aligned with process requirements. They can interpret regulations and apply them to specific design cases.
Solve standard tasks and methodically develop what they have learned to solve more complex tasks. Students question existing solutions regarding material expenditure.

Understand the requirements of the involved disciplines (chemistry, measurement and control engineering, plant planning, manufacturing, assembly, operation), communicate with these disciplines, and professionally implement the specific requirements.
Work in small groups and present the results of their collaboration. They master the essential technical vocabulary.
Demonstrate the application of regulations in an ingeniously efficient manner.

syllabus_topics: Wall thickness calculations for pressure vessels
assessment_rules: The choice of examination type from the given options is up to the respective examiners. The choice of examination type will be communicated to the students at the beginning of the semester. The term paper should be approximately 10 - 20 pages long. For oral examination details, refer to the currently valid General Part of the Examination Regulations (ATPO).
